whenToUse: A pre-launch page collecting emails with a countdown and referral position.
Products not yet live that want proof points and a share link.
avoidWhen: Launched SaaS with pricing — use site-saas-01.
Retail drops with stock — use site-store-02.
a11y: The countdown honours reduced motion (useReducedMotion) and the signed-up state is announced via aria-live.
Ensure the validation error is tied to the email input.
